title: Brently was not in the accident
summary: The report that Brently Mallard was killed is false. He was far from the scene and did not know of any accident.
body: The railroad disaster was real and the list of killed headed by Brently Mallard's name was received and confirmed by a second telegram, but he was far from the scene and did not even know there had been an accident. The text does not say why his name was listed.
